cases.api_call: Vanessa MCP activate_window -> native TestClient internal window activation
cases.ui_target: Existing internal TestClient window selected at runtime from get_window_list_testclient
cases.expected_state: The TestClient is attached and at least one internal window is already open.
cases.pre_state: Active internal window caption is recorded before activation.
cases.post_state: The target already-open internal window is active when the provider can switch it.
cases.recovery_expectation: Reactivate the original internal window when it differs from the selected target.
cases.notes: The safe-action capture records Vanessa tool outputs and raw traffic. Frame-range join remains pending until classification can separate action frames from attach/refresh traffic.
